candidates.title: How to Do a Kettlebell Overhead Press
candidates.description:
Coaching Points:
- Rack kettlebell so it rests on shoulder, forearm, and bicep
- Maintain a straight wrist
- Squeeze glutes and brace torso
- Press overhead in a spiraling motion
